governance.production_task: Hourly Volatility & C2 Conformal Risk Envelope (7-day horizon)
semantic_invariants: Volatility quantile containment (92.84%) is NEVER reported as directional accuracy.
Directional accuracy is NEVER represented as an authorized production trade signal.
Zero live capital execution or live order routing is permitted.

data_contracts.timestamp_convention: Candle open time in UTC (timestamp), available at candle close (available_time)
data_contracts.candle_finalization_rule: Observations are strictly causal: features for bar t are computed only after candle t closes (t + 1 hour).
data_contracts.outage_handling: Gaps greater than 2 hours trigger ABSTAIN_DATA_GAP and are excluded from forward return resolution.

1h.target_definition: Sign of forward 1-hour log return: y_t = 1 if ln(Close_{t+1}/Close_t) > 0 else 0

4h.target_definition: Sign of forward 4-hour log return: y_t = 1 if ln(Close_{t+4}/Close_t) > 0 else 0

24h.target_definition: Sign of forward 24-hour log return: y_t = 1 if ln(Close_{t+24}/Close_t) > 0 else 0

168h_volatility.target_definition: Realized variance over forward 168 hours; evaluated against C2 conformal interval [L_t, U_t]

baselines.name: Prevalence Majority Class
baselines.description: Predicts constant upward movement based on pre-2026 training prevalence (51.2% up).

baselines.name: Canonical Directional GBDT 4-Lag
baselines.description: Frozen GBDT model using 4 return lags.

baselines.name: HAR-RS-DOW C2 Conformal Risk Envelope
baselines.description: Production volatility point forecast with 90% conformal uncertainty bands.

institutional_14bps.turnover_rule: Counts every transition between positions +1, 0 (cash), and -1.

retail_35bps.turnover_rule: Counts every transition between positions +1, 0 (cash), and -1.

stopping_and_inconclusive_criteria.rejection_criterion: Hypothesis of directional edge is rejected if 95% bootstrap lower bound <= 50.0% on N >= 2130 bars.
stopping_and_inconclusive_criteria.seventy_percent_objective_rule: 70% accuracy is NOT substantiated unless prospective N >= 2130 bars yields 95% bootstrap lower bound >= 70.0%.
